t: These are the gates and gatepiers at Albert Gate, on the edge of Westminster. They were designed by Thomas Cubitt, the master builder who did so much to develop London's historic streets and squares, especially in Belgravia, Pimlico and Bloomsbury. The sculpture on them was made by Peter Turnerelli, an Irish-born sculptor of Italian descent who worked in Britain in the early nineteenth century. So this is a small piece of street furniture that brings together one of London's great builders and a sculptor of his era.
